name: Cohors_Cthulhu_Companion
description:
Optional companion for the **Cohors Cthulhu** character sheet (Modiphius 2d20 System). The sheet works without it; this script adds:

* **Momentum and Threat pools** for the whole game, updated automatically by every roll from the sheet and shown in chat, in the Turn Order and on optional "Momentum Pool" / "Threat Pool" tokens.
* **Token actions** for each character's weapons and spells.
* **NPC import**: NPC stat blocks written as JSON become ready-to-play characters, with their tokens.

**Example:** a player's attack generates 2 Momentum, so the pool goes from 3 to 5 and the change is announced in chat. To add NPCs, the GM pastes their JSON into a handout's GM Notes and types `!ccimport handout|Cultists`.

**Commands** (`!cchelp`, `!momentum` and `!threat` are open to everyone; the rest are GM only):

* `!cchelp` - list the commands
* `!momentum` / `!threat` - announce a pool
* `!momentum-set N` / `!threat-set N` - set a pool to N
* `!momentum-adjust N` / `!threat-adjust N` - add N to a pool (negative to subtract)
* `!cctokenactions` - rebuild the weapon and spell token actions for the selected tokens, or every character; `!cctokenactions clear` removes them, `off` / `on` pauses or resumes the automatic updates
* `!ccimport handout|<Handout Name>` - import the NPC JSON in that handout's GM Notes
* `!ccimport tokens` - list the token images the import can find
* `!ccimport token|<Character Name>[|<Token Name>]` - give an existing character its token
* `!ccdebugon` / `!ccdebugoff` - debug logging to the API console

**Configuration:** the pool names, the Momentum cap and the import's token folder and page names are in the CONFIG block at the start of the script.

Full documentation: the [README](https://github.com/Roll20/roll20-api-scripts/tree/master/Cohors_Cthulhu_Companion). The NPC JSON format is described with the sheet: [FORMAT.md](https://github.com/Roll20/roll20-character-sheets/blob/master/Cohors_Cthulhu/npc-import/FORMAT.md).
